visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens with a close-up of a food stall counter where two women in red aprons and light blue surgical masks are busy preparing food. One woman reaches for ingredients while the other holds a plastic-covered plate. The counter is filled with various skewers and trays of oden-style food under bright daylight. (2) A wide handheld shot captures the food stall from across a street, showing a red and white striped awning and customers seated at small tables. A scooter is parked in the foreground. (3) Extreme close-up of long sausages and thick rice sausages grilling on a metal rack, glistening with oil. A pair of metal tongs moves the food. Then, a close-up of a plate containing dark blood cake, cabbage, and skewered items is shown being held. (4) A person uses large metal scissors to snip a grilled, flat fish cake into pieces on a metal tray near the grill. The cut pieces are then shown skewered and placed on a plate. (5) A hand picks up various skewers from a large, steaming metal oden vat partitioned into sections. A metal ladle pours clear, hot soup into a small yellow bowl. (6) Close-up of a dark, rectangular blood cake on a plate being drizzled with bright red tomato sauce from a plastic squeeze bottle. Various other items like bitter melon and pig skin are shown in close-up shots. (7) The camera pans across a wooden menu board on a wall with vertical Chinese text and price tags. The final shot is a wide view of the stall situated directly in front of a traditional Chinese temple with red lanterns and ornate roof decorations.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a male narrator introducing the 30-year-old food stall in a friendly, enthusiastic tone. An upbeat acoustic guitar BGM at approximately 110 BPM plays consistently in the background. (2) A distinct sizzling sound of meat on a grill is heard as the narrator mentions the sausages. The BGM maintains a steady rhythm under the voice. (3) The rhythmic, metallic snip-snip sound of metal scissors cutting food triggers a focus on the texture of the fish cakes. The narrator's pitch is moderately high and engaging. (4) The sound of clear liquid splashing and pouring into a bowl accompanies the description of the hot soup. Ambient outdoor chatter is very faint. (5) A soft squeezing sound of a plastic bottle coincides with the visual of tomato sauce being applied to the food. The BGM remains constant and major-key. (6) The narrator provides address information and a closing sign-off with increasing vocal arousal. The guitar BGM gradually fades out as the clip ends.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a local food recommendation for a 30-year-old stall in Kaohsiung. It uses high-arousal narration and detailed close-ups of grilling sausages and oden to entice the viewer to visit. It emphasizes the homemade quality of the sausages and the variety of choices available.
